claims.summary: Fejer kernel K_L(w) = 2(1 - cos Lw)/(L w^2), off-line pairs gamma_j -+ i delta with multiplicities m_j, b = delta L: the off-line part of the density sum_z m_z K_L(tau - z) equals -(2 e^b/L) Re G(tau) + E(tau) with G(tau) = sum m_j e^{-iL(tau - gamma_j)}/(tau - gamma_j + i delta)^2, |E| <= 6 Y/L, Y = sum m_j/((tau - gamma_j)^2 + delta^2); G(tau) = -int_0^inf x e^{-delta x} P(x - L) e^{i(x-L) tau} dx with P(y) = sum m_j e^{-iy gamma_j}; and the real points contribute at most (7/3) L N(2 pi/L), N a local count.
claims.assessment: Working proof: the complex cosine split into its growing and decaying exponentials, a Laplace transform identity, and a count of real points by distance in units of 2 pi/L.
claims.rationale: The exact form in which an off-line pair makes a density that is nonnegative for real points negative; basis of the three propositions of the entry.
claims.next_action: None; unequal distances are outside it.
claims.formalization_scope: Not formalized; no Lean work assigned.

claims.summary: In the setting of the one-sided density decomposition with b >= 2 pi and all gaps between heights at least 8 delta max(1, sqrt(m'/m_j)) (m' the largest other multiplicity): at tau = gamma_j + pi/L, Re G >= 0.42 m_j/delta^2 and the density is at most R(tau) - (m_j/(L delta^2))(0.84 e^b - 6.36); so it is negative once 0.84 e^b > 6.36 + (7/3) b^2 N(2 pi/L)/m_j.
claims.assessment: Working proof: the pair's own term evaluated at a shift of pi/L, the others bounded by their distances. With a local count of order log T the threshold is b about log log T, a hypothesis on zeros not read in a source.
claims.rationale: In the model a separated off-line pair forces a negative value of the one-sided density at every length beyond a threshold logarithmic in the local count; the corresponding prime-side premise is unavailable.
claims.next_action: None for separated pairs; clusters are the open case.
claims.formalization_scope: Not formalized; no Lean work assigned.

claims.summary: In the setting of the one-sided density decomposition, with H_jl = 2/(2 delta + i(gamma_j - gamma_l))^3, J = int_0^inf x^2 e^{-2 delta x} |P(x - L)|^2 dx >= lambda_min(H) sum m_j^2 > 0, A1 = pi delta^2 J/M, eps = 2 pi L e^{-b} M and W the span of the heights: sup_tau Re G >= (A1/4 - eps/2)/(W + 16 M/A1); the lower bound for J does not depend on L, so no cluster makes the off-line part of the density nonnegative at arbitrarily large lengths.
claims.assessment: Working proof: Plancherel for G, nonnegativity of the integral of G^2, the integral of G by inversion, and the decay of G away from the heights. The constant is of order J^2 and far from sharp (ratios 10^2 to 10^10 in the control); no lower bound for lambda_min(H) under a local count is obtained.
claims.rationale: Answers the route review's test: a cluster cannot hide in the one-sided form, with a constant independent of the length.
claims.next_action: A lower bound for the constant for n pairs in a window of height delta under the local count.
claims.formalization_scope: Not formalized; no Lean work assigned.

claims.summary: In the setting of the one-sided density decomposition, with theta_j = L(gamma_j - gamma_1), k the number of vanishing moments sum m_j e^{iL gamma_j} theta_j^r and c_k = sum m_j |theta_j|^k: |G(tau)| <= (k+1) c_k/(delta^2 b^k) for all tau, so the negative part of the off-line density is at most (2 e^b/L)(k+1) c_k/(delta^2 b^k) + 6M/(L delta^2).
claims.assessment: Working proof: Taylor expansion of the exponential sum at the endpoint, as in the endpoint moment order. The one-sided density loses the power b^(-k) at the lengths where the second moment loses b^(-2k).
claims.rationale: Shows the one-sided form does not escape the cluster loss of the second moment.
